dispute_resolution_policy.content: Dispute Resolution Policy v4. (1) Pricing disputes (wrong rate, missing discount, tax error on exempt item) may be credited once validated against the master pricing schedule and any applicable contract. (2) Duplicate-charge disputes require confirmation from provisioning/delivery logs before crediting. (3) Service-delivery disputes ('not delivered') must be routed to the services team for delivery confirmation and are NOT eligible for automatic pricing credit. (4) All credit amounts must match the validated overcharge from source records. (5) An AR lead must approve the resolution batch before credits are issued, statuses are changed, or customers are notified.

tools.name: query_dispute_tracker
tools.description: Read the pending customer invoice dispute cases and their current statuses from the Dispute Tracker.

tools.name: retrieve_original_invoices
tools.description: Retrieve the original invoice line items and amounts referenced by the dispute cases.

tools.name: retrieve_pricing_schedule
tools.description: Retrieve the master pricing schedule, contract rates, and volume discount tiers to validate disputed amounts.

tools.name: evaluate_against_dispute_policy
tools.description: Evaluate each dispute case against the dispute resolution policy to classify it (valid pricing credit, needs documentation, route to services) and compute the validated credit amount.

tools.name: draft_dispute_resolution_package
tools.description: Compile a draft resolution package summarizing each case's classification, validated credit amount, and recommended next step for the user's approval. Does not change any case, issue any credit, or notify anyone.

tools.name: issue_customer_credit_memo
tools.description: Create a credit memo entry in the Resolutions sheet, issuing a financial credit to the customer's account.

tools.name: update_dispute_case_status
tools.description: Update a dispute case's status in the Dispute Tracker (e.g., to 'Resolved' or 'Credited').

tools.name: send_customer_outcome_notification
tools.description: Email the customer notifying them of the dispute outcome and any credit applied.

tools.name: email_ar_lead_summary
tools.description: Send a summary email to the AR lead with resolved dispute counts and total credit value.

tools.name: lookup_ar_team_directory
tools.description: Look up AR team member names, roles, and email addresses.

tools.name: read_ar_announcements
tools.description: Read recent AR team announcements and reminders.
